title: Very good reminder app
body: This app works great for reminders. I have been using it for about 2 years. Previously, I had various reminders in Apple's native calendar, clock and reminder apps plus a third party timer app but now, this app has taken the place of all 4 apps. I would still wish for 3 enhancements for this to be the perfect reminder app for me: 1) for me to use my own music or custom ringtones for the alerts as the alerts that come with the app are mostly too brief and don't attract one's attention; 2) to allow for reminders to be repeated during the space of 24 hours or less (to remind for things like medications every 6 hours, drink water every 2 hours from 11 am to 11 pm, etc); 3) to include a widget that can be added to the iPhone's Notifications screen. If these three enhancements can be made, this app would be perfect and I would definitely pay for the upgrade whereas the current enhancements for version 3 are frankly not attractive enough for me to do an upgrade. Thank you, developers, for coming up with this very useful app!

title: Incredibly intuitive and functional reminder and timer app
body:
This app continues to impress and I would still use the same three words - clean, smart, effective. (I have been using the app since its inception) Runs flawlessly on iOS8 and on my iPhone 6. Anyway, this is a spanking new and great update for users like me who continue to use it daily. 

I have tried organising my life with hardcopy organisers and setting calendar reminders but so far they are not as effective as Due. Due is great for a quick reminder to be set, yet has sufficient further features such as recurring reminders, address book integration, smart date/time recognition, sharing functions, etc that it can be as simple as you want, yet as functional if you desire.

As mentioned in my previous review some years back, it remains highly intuitive with the commonly used functions readily available such as quick setting of timings to 4 customisable favourite times and the quick way of snoozing different increments once the reminder kicks in. Everything feels right where they should be and the developer pays close attention to feedback and improves the app often. 

The reminder sounds available are plentiful and effective, and in fact with 2.0, we're too spoilt for choice! The app has come a long way and I have had no regrets using it for the past few years. Continue to surprise with more refinement and new features!

title: Reusable timers and alarms. Don't care for quality?—look elsewhere.
body:
Very well-designed, both functionally and aesthetically. Allows you to reuse and modify timers with ease, if, for example, you had to get up at different times every morning. The aptly-named egg timers are also useful, the skeuomorphic interface pleasing but not hindering.

The app design contains many subtle touches, such as the pinstriped background and the soft ticking when you start an egg timer; wonderful attention to detail has been paid.

All in all, an excellent app. The Dropbox functionality is useful for syncing timers across your iPhone and iPad. Those looking for a simple alarm app to wake them in the morning may well be justified in thinking that $4.99 is a little steep—that said, I don't regret purchasing this, so that's as good an indication as any.
